canvas.layerModel: Every structure is authored as a full-canvas layer with an area mask and a border mask. Masks, not hand-tuned rectangles, define the clickable geometry, so a painted layer can be replaced without editing configuration.

layoutPolicy.authority: Latest27October user rejection: rebuild town coherently in painted2D HoMM3 aesthetics.
layoutPolicy.composition: Silhouette-planned dark chempunk borough: huge rear civic/foundry institutions, practical winding lanes, supported entrances, inhabited facade edges, green/violet neon windows and weathered Zaun crest graffiti.
layoutPolicy.functionalBoundary: Eighteen ordinary visible institutions plus optional coast and Grail; all36 states preserved. Zaun preserves eighteen independently visible land institutions: seven tier dwellings, hall, fort, guild, tavern, market, forge, boiler silo, augmentation workshop, clinic, bounded Sump utility and fighting pit. Combining them would hide functional services and destroy the reviewed whole-city architecture; coast and Grail remain two optional sites.
layoutPolicy.siteGeometry: Exact twenty composition rectangles/state render limits and dry support are merged into sites; full-canvas origins remain0,0; alpha-derived masks supply click geometry. No equal-scale grid or unintended solid-body overlap.
layoutPolicy.supersedes: The user-rejected sparse rocky town/foreground-to-background universal scaling quota; native hallSlots are a separate consumer.

siege.shooterRule: The tier three chemical construct is the siege shooter of the town, so the siege screen shows a construct on the walls. It is a machine, not a person, and it fires its own pressurised shot.

siteGroupingNote: Twenty independent sites cover all 36 authored building states: three chain sites (the four hall states, the three fortification states and the four mage guild states), seven dwelling sites with two states each, six service sites (tavern, market, forge, shimmer factory, wharf with its moored barge, and the grail hall) and four special sites. The Fighting Pit is its own independent site: it is a fourth special building that pays a daily wage and is not a construction stage of the tier seven dwelling. State arithmetic: 4 + 3 + 4 + 14 + 7 + 4 = 36 states over 20 sites.

subject: Zaun town visual contract: site plan, construction states, click geometry, adventure objects, siege and visual direction.
visualDirection: One dark chempunk Zaun iron-and-glass neighborhood, organic streets/alleys/industrial platforms and inhabited edges; toxic low light, local vivid chemical green, deep violet shadow and rust-brown masonry. Much larger physically grand rear institutions; readable front façades. Neon chemical green is localized glass/lamps, with purple Shimmer/cloth and brown rust. No universal near/far size ratio, plot-grid or three horizontal terrace bands.
